# HighStreetExpress
> UK's fastest food delivery — fresh food, hot meals & groceries delivered in 10 minutes.

## About
HighStreetExpress (HSX) is a UK 10-minute food delivery app. We deliver fresh food, hot meals, snacks and groceries to your door in under 10 minutes. Founded by Vivek Saxena. Contact: riders@highstreetexpress.com | +44 07818 923405.

## What We Deliver
- Fresh meals and hot food
- Snacks and drinks
- Groceries and essentials
- Desserts and bakery items

## Why Customers Choose HighStreetExpress
- ⚡ 10-minute delivery — the fastest food delivery in the UK
- Free delivery on orders above £20
- Secure payment (Visa, Mastercard and more)
- Friendly UK-based support team
- Fresh, quality food every time
